title: feat(spec): offer dataset member synonyms and description on the dataset form
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbGjBHBVVt6AwhTdfxq71C4s)_

Fixes #31660

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:Studio 数据集表单的维度与度量行,新增「同义词」「描述」两列(ADR-0149 D1),附说明文字与 10 种语言译文;删掉对账测试里这四个键的 4 条 `omit` 行。
- 为什么改:这两个键早已可写,#31589 落地后已被数据集 AI 工具读取(liveness 均为 live),但在 Studio 里建的数据集没有入口填写,AI 问数的命中率因此打折。
- 风险与回滚:只动表单布局、翻译包与测试计数,不动 schema;回滚即 revert 本 PR。同义词输入沿用行编辑器现有的逗号分隔输入,含逗号的短语无法录入。
- 先看:`packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.form.ts`(四行新增与说明文字);`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts`(译文);`packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`(删的四行)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`,预期全绿;Studio 打开任一数据集,维度/度量行里出现「同义词」「描述」。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/ui/dataset.form.ts`: the dimensions and measures repeaters each offer `synonyms` and `description` as row properties, `label` equal to the item schema's `.meta({ title })`, with help text: synonyms are the words people use in a question, matched by the dataset AI tools and never shown (at most 20, each at most 60 characters, one member per word); description is a plain-language business definition, published with the analytics metadata and read by the dataset AI tools, never a prompt (at most 500 characters).
- `packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`: the four `kind: 'omit'` rows for `dataset` × `dimensions`/`measures` × `synonyms`/`description` are removed (their reason, "planned, not yet read", stopped being true when the readers landed; `packages/spec/liveness/dataset.json` marks all four `live`).
- `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`: regenerated with `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, then the eight new leaves hand-translated in the nine translated locales (values only); re-running `--write` dropped their `source-hashes` entries except fr's two `Description` cognate leaves, which the generator records as copies, matching the dataset's existing root `description` entry.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/metadata-form-zh-cn.ts`: the zh-CN mirror carries the same four rows.
- Two count pins in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/`: the zh-CN positive control 733 to 737 (four row labels) and `DATASET_LEAVES` 40 to 48 (four rows, label plus help text).
- Changeset `31660-dataset-member-vocabulary-form.md`: `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` patch.

The row editor (`SchemaForm` repeater) derives each row property's widget from the item schema: `synonyms` (array of strings) renders as the comma-separated string-list input, `description` (I18nLabel) as the same control `label` already uses. No `type`/`widget` is set on the rows, per the existing row-property convention.

## Tests

- `@objectstack/spec`: `vitest run src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts src/ui/` green (180 files, 6360 tests).
- `@objectstack/platform-objects`: full `vitest run` green (120 files, 1932 tests) after the two pin updates; before them, three reds named exactly the new rows (two counts, one fr en-echo, fixed by "Description de la dimension / de la mesure" as the fr precedent spells sibling rows).
- `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs`: all bundles in sync.
- `ui/`: `node scripts/check-i18n-en-drift.mjs` 0 findings.

## Acceptance notes

- `synonyms` entry inherits the repeater's comma-separated input: a synonym containing a comma cannot be typed in Studio (it can in code). Noted, not filed: no shipped synonym needs a comma.
